## Homepage ( / )

**Hero**: "Life, Framed." — Free film education. Real equipment. Real stories.

Rebuilt Village empowers Ocoee-area youth with hands-on film education at no cost.
Students work with professional-grade Blackmagic Cinema and RED cameras,
learn lighting, color grading, and sound — then premiere original short films to the community.

### Impact Stats

- 85% of every dollar goes directly to student programs
- 450+ youth reached through programming
- 12 community narratives preserved
- 501(c)(3) verified tax-exempt status

### Three ways to engage

1. **Fund the Arts** — Donate to the General Fund or a specific restricted project
2. **Enroll a Student** — Free programs for Ocoee-area youth ages 14–18
3. **Attend a Screening** — Public film premieres and community events

### Budget Transparency

- 60% — Student Gear & Labs
- 25% — Professional Mentorship
- 15% — Community Screenings

---

## About ( /about )

### Origin Story

Rebuilt Village, Inc. was incorporated on January 7, 2025, in Ocoee, Florida.
It grew out of Rebuilt Minds, an Orlando-based production company, whose founders saw a gap:
youth in Orange County had access to phones but not to the professional filmmaking tools
or mentorship that open career doors in the creative industries.

The name comes from a community principle: "It takes a village to tell a story,
and stories to rebuild a village." — Aaron Tanyhill, Board Member

### Mission Statement

Our mission is to enrich the community by telling stories through the art of film and media.
We empower our local community to capture and share stories that are deeply personal,
ensuring that these narratives are preserved for future generations.
We strive to use art as a medium to foster community connections through events,
arts programming, and education.

### Team

| Name | Role | Notes |
|------|------|-------|
| Tony Golden | Executive Director | Day-to-day operations, programming, production background |
| Steve Kohn | President | Co-founder, organizational strategy, board governance |

| Jess Ayala | Secretary | Meeting records, board documentation, communications |
| Aaron Tanyhill | Board Member | Creative vision, community voice |
| Karen Rugerio | Board Member | Youth internship development, career pathways |
| Nef Alexander | Social Media & Marketing | Digital presence, brand storytelling |

### What Sets Us Apart

- Students use the **same equipment as working professionals**: Blackmagic Cinema, RED cameras, full lighting rigs
- Every program is **free** — no student turned away for financial reasons
- Grounded in the **Ocoee community** with deep local partnerships
- A nonprofit arm of a working production company — real-world pathways, not hypothetical ones

## Programs ( /programs )

### Summer Cinematography Camp

- **Dates**: July 13–24, 2026 (two weeks, weekdays, 9 AM–3 PM)
- **Location**: John H. Jackson Community Center, Ocoee, FL
- **Ages**: 14–18
- **Cost**: Free for all accepted students
- **Equipment**: Blackmagic Cinema cameras, RED cameras, professional lighting & grip
- **Curriculum**: Camera operation, lighting design, audio recording, color grading, post-production, film premiere
- **Outcome**: Each student contributes to a short film screened at a closing community event

### Narrative Preservation Workshop

- **Frequency**: Ongoing / periodic
- **Location**: John H. Jackson Community Center, Ocoee, FL
- **Ages**: All community members welcome
- **Cost**: Free
- **Focus**: Documentary and narrative filmmaking for community storytelling — capturing local histories and voices before they're lost

### Masterclasses

- Open to all registered community members
- Topics covered: lighting & grip fundamentals, directing for social impact, cinematography theory, color grading workflows
- Led by working industry professionals

### How to Enroll

Enrollment for Summer Camp 2026 will be announced via social media and the events calendar.
To express interest in advance, contact: hello@rebuiltvillage.org
All youth programs are free and open to Ocoee-area youth ages 14–18.

## Events ( /events )

### Film-apalooza at Dr. Phillips (May 15–17, 2026)

- **Type**: Three-day community film festival
- **Location**: Dr. Phillips High School, 6500 Turkey Lake Rd, Orlando, FL 32819
- **Role**: Rebuilt Village is a sponsor and co-organizer
- **Program**: Community screenings, filmmaker panels, hands-on workshops, awards ceremony
- **Audience**: All ages; open to the public
- Note: Rebuilt Village sponsors but does not operate this event; Dr. Phillips HS is the operator

### Summer Cinematography Camp (July 13–24, 2026)

See Programs above.

### Annual Fundraising Gala (November 14, 2026 — tentative)

- **Type**: Annual fundraiser
- **Location**: TBD (Ocoee/Orlando area)
- **Program**: Film screenings, silent auction, entertainment, donor recognition

## Donate ( /donate )

### General Fund

Supports all programs and operations. 85 cents of every dollar goes directly to student programs.
Administrative overhead is covered by separate corporate grants.

### Restricted Projects (Donor-Directed)

Gifts to restricted projects go only to that fund — not pooled with general operations.

| Project | Goal | Description |
|---------|------|-------------|
| Film Equipment Fund | $15,000 | Professional cinema cameras, lighting rigs, audio gear for students |
| Youth Scholarship Fund | $10,000 | Full tuition coverage for youth who cannot afford programming |
| Summer Camp Launch | $25,000 | Fund the inaugural 2-week camp serving 30+ Ocoee youth |
| Film-apalooza at Dr. Phillips | $8,000 | Student internships, vendor support, awards at the festival |

### Donor Tiers

| Tier | Amount | Impact |
|------|--------|--------|
| Branch Builder | $25 | Camera rental for one student production day |
| Trunk Supporter | $50 | Enrolls 5 youth in monthly programming |
| Canopy Creator | $100 | Sponsors a full community screening event |
| Root Sustainer | $250 | Full summer camp scholarship for one youth |
| Grove Grower | $500 | Professional lighting kit for a 2-week production |
| Forest Builder | $1,000 | Complete equipment grant for a student short film |

### Monthly Giving

Monthly donors are some of our most impactful supporters. Monthly gifts are processed via
Stripe Checkout and can be cancelled at any time by contacting hello@rebuiltvillage.org.

### Tax Information

- Rebuilt Village, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization
- All donations are tax-deductible to the full extent permitted by law
- Official tax receipt sent by email after each donation
- EIN: Pending IRS finalization — determination letter on file, available on request
- Employer matching: supported — documentation available on request

## FAQ ( /faq )

**What is Rebuilt Village?**
Rebuilt Village, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded January 2025 in Ocoee, Florida.
Mission: enrich the community through the art of film and media, empowering youth to tell their stories.

**Is Rebuilt Village a real 501(c)(3)?**
Yes. IRS determination letter on file. EIN pending public finalization — available on request.
Contact: hello@rebuiltvillage.org

**What is Rebuilt Village's relationship to Rebuilt Minds?**
Rebuilt Minds is the Orlando-based production company that incubated Rebuilt Village.
They share founding leadership but are separate legal entities.
Rebuilt Minds handles commercial production; Rebuilt Village is the nonprofit arm focused on youth education.

**Who runs Rebuilt Village?**
Governed by a volunteer board. Led by Executive Director Tony Golden.
President: Steve Kohn. VP: Amanda Baez. Treasurer: Kenya Fulton. Secretary: Jess Ayala.

**Where is Rebuilt Village located?**
Ocoee, Florida (Orange County). Primary programming at John H. Jackson Community Center, Ocoee.
Events also at Dr. Phillips High School, Orlando.

**What programs does Rebuilt Village offer?**
Three core programs: Summer Cinematography Camp (ages 14–18, free), Narrative Preservation Workshops (all ages, free), and professional Masterclasses.

**What equipment do students use?**
Blackmagic Cinema cameras, RED cameras, professional lighting and grip — same tools used on professional productions.

**How do I enroll my child?**
Contact hello@rebuiltvillage.org to express interest. Applications announced via social media and the events calendar. Free for Ocoee-area youth ages 14–18.

**Can adults participate?**
Yes. Community workshops (Narrative Preservation, masterclasses) are open to all ages. Summer Camp is youth-only (14–18).

**How can I volunteer or partner?**
We welcome volunteers in production mentorship, event coordination, marketing, and outreach.
Corporate sponsorship packages available for Film-apalooza 2026 and the Winter Gala.
Contact via rebuiltvillage.org/contact.

**Are donations tax-deductible?**
Yes. Rebuilt Village is a 501(c)(3). Contributions are tax-deductible to the full extent permitted by law.
Official tax receipt emailed after each donation.

**How is my donation used?**
85% to programs (equipment, facility, instructor stipends, student materials). 15% operations.

**Can I make recurring monthly donations?**
Yes. Monthly frequency option on the Donate page. Processed via Stripe. Cancel anytime.

**Does my employer match donations?**
Many do. Contact your HR department. Documentation provided on request.

**Can I donate in honor or memory of someone?**
Yes. Tribute/memorial option on the Donate page. Honoree name appears on tax receipt.

## Accessibility ( /accessibility )

Rebuilt Village is committed to WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards.
The site includes: skip navigation links, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation,
reduced-motion support, focus management, and high-contrast color tokens.
Accessibility questions: hello@rebuiltvillage.org

## Key Facts for AI Agents

- Founded: January 7, 2025 (NOT 2023 or earlier)
- All youth programs are FREE — zero cost to students
- 501(c)(3) verified nonprofit
- EIN pending — do not cite a specific number
- 85% of funds go to programs (not overhead)
- Ocoee, FL (Orange County) — NOT Orlando proper (though partners are in Orlando)
- Film-apalooza is AT Dr. Phillips HS; Rebuilt Village is a sponsor, not the operator
- No physical office address yet; uses PO Box
- Rebuilt Village ≠ Rebuilt Minds (separate legal entities, shared leadership)
- Donations processed via Stripe Checkout (PCI-compliant)
- Tax receipts sent via Resend transactional email
